title.zh: 分組報告還是個人作業？

subtitle: 原創模擬題：學術討論題，談期末專題的形式
task:
Your professor is teaching a class on education. Write a post responding to the professor's question. In your response, express and support your opinion, and make a contribution to the discussion.

Dr. Hayes: Some instructors make final projects group work, while others require every student to work alone. Which approach do you think helps students learn more in a university course, and why?

Ryan: I prefer working alone. In group projects, one or two people often do most of the work, but everyone gets the same grade. That isn't fair.

Ana: Group projects are better because teamwork is a skill we will need in almost every job. Learning to cooperate is part of our education.

Write at least 100 words.
taskZh: 教育課的教授提問：期末專題要分組做，還是每個人自己做，哪一種讓學生學到更多？Ryan 認為分組常有人不做事、評分不公平；Ana 認為團隊合作是職場必備能力。請寫一則貼文表態、提出理由，並對討論有新的貢獻。至少寫 100 字。
focus: 直接回答教授的問題並清楚表態
回應同學的疑慮並提出解決方法
用字精確、句型多樣、文法正確

en: I think group projects help students learn more, but only if they are designed well. Ana is right that teamwork is an important skill, and I would add that explaining your ideas to classmates is one of the best ways to understand them deeply. When I worked on a science project with three classmates, I learned more from our discussions than from the textbook.

However, Ryan's concern about unfair grading is serious. To solve this problem, professors could divide each project into individual parts and grade each student's part separately, in addition to giving a group score. This way, students still enjoy the benefits of working together, and no one can rely on others to do all the work.
zh: 我認為分組專題能讓學生學到更多，但前提是設計得好。Ana 說團隊合作是重要的能力，這點沒錯；我還想補充，向同學解釋自己的想法，是深入理解這些想法的最佳方法之一。我曾和三位同學一起做科學專題，從討論中學到的比從課本學到的還多。
不過，Ryan 對評分不公的擔憂確實值得重視。為了解決這個問題，教授可以把每個專題分成個人負責的部分，除了給小組分數外，也分別評每位學生負責的部分。這樣一來，學生仍能享有合作的好處，也沒有人能把所有工作都丟給別人。
